args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS
WITH cohort_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participants p2 WHERE p2.cohort = p1.cohort) as cohort_size
    FROM participants p1
    GROUP BY cohort
),
example_notes AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort,
        first_value(contact_notes IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort ORDER BY participant_id) as example_comment
    FROM participants
)
SELECT 
    cd.cohort,
    cd.cohort_size,
    CASE 
        WHEN en.example_comment IS NULL THEN 'No contact notes available for review'
        ELSE en.example_comment
    END as example_comment
FROM cohort_data cd
LEFT JOIN example_notes en ON cd.cohort = en.cohort
ORDER BY cd.cohort;
